observations: Multiple pairs of drumsticks in four colors: black, white, yellow, and neon green.
The sticks are individually wrapped in clear plastic sleeves and grouped into bundles.
A black paper band around the bundles features the 'VIC' logo in white text.
The sticks and tips appear to be made of the same solid-colored material, suggesting plastic or nylon.
The background shows retail packaging for other audio equipment like microphones.

claims.evidence: Vic Firth is a professional brand, but the specific model and material (appearing to be plastic) are not confirmed as professional-grade.

risks.proof: A clear, high-resolution photo of the branding and model name printed directly on the stick shaft.
A close-up photo of an unwrapped stick showing the surface texture (wood grain vs. smooth plastic).
A statement or photo clarifying if the price is for one pair, one color bundle, or the entire lot.

proof_requests: Photo of the text printed on the side of a single stick.
Photo of a stick out of the plastic wrapping to confirm material.
Confirmation of how many pairs are included for the price.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as drum sticks. While the specific model is not visible, they can be priced at the worst-case value of generic synthetic sticks.
